name: Cue
tagline: A morning call sheet for every scheduled bot you have running
description: Think of it as the stage manager for your automations. Each morning it posts a plain-language rundown of what is due to fire and when, points out where two jobs are about to trip over each other, and speaks up the moment a routine errors out or simply never runs at all.
author: DBCrypto
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
